svg.title: Reconstructed memory map view with export action
svg.desc: A memory map aggregated from SPI/I2C bus captures, showing address ranges by observation state, a completeness summary, and an export control for producing a binary or hex dump.
svg.text: Aggregated from 214 SPI/I2C bus transactions · session #REC-0042

g.text: Each cell = one address block. Brighter red = more fully observed.
